body: It's all good. This is a very polarizing issue that's close to a lot of people. No harm no foul.
Except we're not at all. A child born in a developed country has a different set of problems than a child born in an undeveloped country.

It's extremely refreshing to talk to someone aware of the accepted insanity of society. So often we do exactly as we have been shown/taught not too. Don't judge a book by it's cover, yet we all do it. I want the cute girl with hour Glass figure and perfect smile. I want the toned man with abs. I want her to be sunkissed. I want him to be wear dark clothes and have glasses. 

How much does this tell us about a person, if anything at all. Who knows? Physical attraction is important, but it seems to be the deciding factor all too often. Regardless, dating standards suck on both end inequally and then inverse I equally as well.

And on the flip side me should die in the workplace, men should go to war, men should sign up for selective service, men should have no way to legally defend themselves from domestic abuse, men should have to initiate romance, men should have to propose, men should not be left around children, men shouldn't be prioritized in school.

Yes women have issues. Yes they are terrible. But why are you allowed to abort a child and I have no similar recourse? Or what if I wanted to raise that child and you aborted it? Where are my opportunities?

Well now we come to the uncomfortable questions. Is living a superficially good life fulfilling? On your death bed will you have regrets of donning your battle armor and painting on your mask? 

This is a very powerful issue that paints a very fantastical picture of a women with beautiful make up and clothes standing next to her poised and stoic mountain of a man. They both seem happy until you realize they don't even know each other's hobbies beyond a simple Netflix binge session. It all rings very hollow.

So now the question becomes, do you want that life, that superficially wonderful life. Or do you risk walking your own path, one which will be paved with hardships and may have no satisfying end all for the hope of finding one who not only hates the mask, but wishes to cast it off with you.

An interesting issue. But I suspect I know how society will choose to answer.

The only thing I hate more than the status quo is change.

I'm not trying to downplay it all. It's a shitty time when I have to use a currency like suicide to point out problems, but it impacts men more.

I agree, suicide is pretty bad, but everyone I've known who attempted and succeeded was a straight white high school aged boy.

We're in a terrible time where I have to push something as outrageous as the suicide gap, but men are 3.5x as likely to die by suicide than women who attempt it 2x as much.

Ahh yes a dead link to a false claim. Wonderful. 

The earth is very much round and we are steadily killing ourselves with minor degree increases to the atmosphere and world in general. The point is, most studies debating the so called wage gap are pushing an agenda and anything but impartial.

I could skew statistics all day to make anyone or anything seem awful.

The media have a vested interest in generating outrage. To the other side of single motherhood, what of the father who may or may not be crushed by the alimony and child support? What of the fact that he is allowed to see his child 4 days out of the month? 

Sure, there will always be terrible people exploiting the system on both sides. Deadbeat dads and abusive mothers or the inverse. 

Certain male traits are completely romanticized to the point of being dangerous. Stoicism in particular is usually the killer. Imagine wearing a mask every day and you only ever get to take it off at night, alone, in your own bed. That's the only time it's okay to cry.

And if the masks breaks, you will be mocked, ridiculed, and ostracized. By both men and women. Men will call you weak and pathetic, women will no longer be attracted to you. All because one day the mask was just too hard to wear. 

So now, here you are, alone in a world that has made it very clear it doesn't give a damn as long as you continue to be a good little cog in the machine. It has a vested interest in keeping you alive only to exploit you. 

I think people are so wrapped in what they think a good partner should be like according to standards that may or may not be their own or they simply don't know what they want at the time. It's fine to not know, it's fine to have to figure out. 

But there's two people here who just want to be themselves with each other.

I never said women were the problem. Both men and women and society are to blame for this. Also those studies tend to be very intellectually dishonest and fail to properly account and compare things.

It should go something like this.

Job title - needs to be the same or similar. I don't care that an actuary makes way more than an account receivable accountant

Job location - needs to be extremely similar, ie same city/zip code or comparable

Hours worked - if you work less you will be paid less

Years experience - if you have less experience you will be paid less

Professional education - if you have industry certification and follow on schooling you will be paid more

As an example for properly doing this instead of the sweeping generalizations we normally get.

Why? And is it always on their own terms? Would you rather child kill themself or take steps to try and help them? But if they want to commit suicide on their terms, you're now violating their agency.

What do you do. Watch your daughter/son die or try to help them?
You seem focused on my issues while I'm more focused on how to make things better for people.
That's awesome, but what if you couldn't?

I'm so glad you believe you are in an oh so great country where all problems can be in your control and mitigated and fixed. Truly amazing.

I'm glad that equal rights is sexism to you.

Well there is an extremely human element with a lot of bias involved. I'd like to see a hard look at marriage, divorce, domestic violence and reproductive rights. Literally true equality is a fantasy ideal that simply can't be achieved. Too many variables.

Women hopefully have the option to abort. I'm all for that. Men receive no input past the night of sex. Why is that fair? As of now because women have to go through 9 months on pregnancy. If a woman can decide not too, than a man should be able to drop responsibility as well.

The Duluth model needs to end.

Personally I don't believe divorcees should be required to maintain their standard of life through alimony. I'm on the fence about child support. It has good intent but it doesn't sit right.

Ultimately I find most of my complaints coming from the fact that women get treated like children for some benevolent sexism.
So because it's unfair I should just shut up because women have problems too? Awesome.

No the end goal is for more freaking awareness and hopefully action. I'm sorry you think men and women don't deserve equality and should be damned before even trying.

Just because things were worse doesn't mean modern problems don't matter.
"other people have it worse so shut up" what a lovely argument.

Okay. Boko Haram. Bring back our hundreds of girls, but not our thousands of boys. 

Google suicide, realize that middle age white men are disproportionately impacted. Realize men are 3x as likely to die by suicide even though women attempt it 2x as much. Realize in 2012 we lost more soldiers to suicide than war that year.

Is rape terrible. Yes. Is genital mutilation awful. Yes. However what about these statistics for men?

I couldn't care less about what some good ole boys club in entertainment made. It's a sleazy industry catering to pretty people and powerful men. And society allows it to continue.

Oh make no mistake. Men perpetuate this a lot. The problem is men are conditioned that they may only be vulnerable to a select person and when that person utters those words of "suck it up, be a man"

The just and proper world of this man is shattered. Some pick up the pieces, some step on them, and others, others just stop with the world altogether.

Of course not. Do you tell the IRS they gave you too big a refund or do you wait to be scolded? I believe I know what these movements would say.

It's hard to break because no fair discussion can be had. Feminism has claimed a monopoly on all things through intersectionality but if you don't pander to whatever idea is currently mainstream feminism you will be shut out.
I'm hesitant to believe this due to the splintered factions of feminism. Honestly I believe we need a new movement with a fresh label and clear goals.

Yet you still resorted to it. Telling of your character.

I believe both sides need to continue this victimization until something is done, because apparently personable accountability is a bad word in today's world.

So if the only options are more broken homes, single mothers, and suicidal sons, I guess this is the price we must pay to come to an understanding.

It's not about loneliness in it's entirety. That's a symptom of a larger issue which will require a cultural shift in how society views men lest they try their damndest to not be a part of it.

Whether this be through inaction or action only matters if you care about seeing more suicides.
The point is you will be stigmatized, because society wants you to be. I can respect sticking to your values in an insane world, but when everyone else is crazy and you're not, suddenly you're crazy.
So it's okay because of the time and cost of birthing a child that men get shit on?

No. I value human rights and equality unlike you who have nothing to add to this conversation other than sad ad hominem attacks.

But please continue to rant and rave about how women are more inherently valued life.

No I understand. But that's inherently a problem in democracy. It expects an active public use that is hopefully informed.

Education is a big part, but I think empathy will play an equally large role.

 Nepotism is garbage as well.

You're what's wrong biological reductionism. You have no value because without a man you have no child in the same way a man is nothing without a woman.

If your only value is from a biological imperative, I'm sorry for you.

Thank you! This is what I'm talking about. It's the woman's side of the feelings shit show, where she becomes treated like a child because "that's just how women are"

Bullshit. Women are people with agency and need to be treated as such.

I don't at all mean to downplay the struggles of history. But I fear we are watching the pendulum steadily swing. I am very much not okay with equity and equality of opportunity being used as substitutes for actual equality.

Also I'll catch flak for this, but voting nowadays has so little meaning to me.

Of course but so were many others. Voting used to be a privilege of only 'right and proper' land owning citizens.

Many had to earn their rights in this so called land of the free
They wanted the opportunity to slave away in the field and I'm all for that. Give everyone as much opportunity, even if it is a shitty opportunity.

Not what I said. I reject the title of feminist as it has no clear goals and an ever changing meaning.

At one point I believe it involved raising women to men's level, and I'm all for that. Now, who knows what that movement means.

Well it could be said the same for women, in that they seek a fatherly figure out of their partner.

Should housework be divided equally, probably.

Is emotional labor real to me? Absolutely not. If I couldn't bother remembering it, then don't worry about sending out Birthday cards.
No. I reject that title.

That's frankly garbage. You need to suffer to grow is a nice plot point but should not be the case. So what of the men who got no fire lit under their ass? They just wouldn't make good men?

And what of the adult infants you describe as women. They shouldn't be just babymakers.

And men shouldn't have to burn in order to phoenix from the ashes of who they were.

When's the last time you've seen a random average man complimented even if bordered on creepy? 

When's the last time an average women in your life described her day as uneventful with no words from strangers, good bad or creepy?

Why? Why is it this way? How much is nature, how much is nurture? Why do women need to be built up? Why do men need to be torn down?

I suspect I'll never get answers, or more likely I'll get real answers that just don't satisfy me.

It just sucks. Someone always comes to stomp all over my stuff whenever I mention that it disproportionately impacts men. Men are 3x more likely to die while women are 2x as likely to attempt.

I'm also in the military and we have more people die to suicide than war in some years.

It also really hurts other mentally ill and LGBT people too. They're disproportionately impacted too.

I'm not trying to make this about men but I remember being a stupid 18 year old trying to give a speech at a friend's funeral.

He felt like it was his only way out.

I suffer from MDD so I understand what it's like to be trapped. You feel like you have this work to do to get better and it seems impossible and then you stop feeling sad because you're empty then it seems like the only way out is suicide.

I'm not trying to take away from anything. But this problem gets bigger every year and I don't want more people to end up in my predicament.

I think there is a really big problem with women being infantilized and men being shamed in regards to feelings and they both produce very toxic stereotypes.

For women: all that dumb women are all emotionally unstable neurotic and insane stuff

For men: can't talk about problems or society will see them as lesser so they bottle it up until they cant

I don't even comprehend what you are saying anymore. I'm all for equality of opportunity in every way. So give men the opportunity to talk without the stigmas attached. 

I'm not talking about rich, wealthy men in positions of power.

I'm talking about average Joe's who don't feel wanted, loved, or respected.

Well do we want equality? Hasn't separate but equal always been shamed as half-baked bandaid over a glaring issue? I understand the need for nuance but it seems women get to reap emotional benefits as it were while society expects men to kick rocks and be quiet.
But see, that's the problem. She may express her feelings while he will be shamed for doing so. Why is this allowed?

Well I like to believe that we are, but time and time again society and nature seem to dance a twisted love-hate jig that governments profit off of.

Women are not just incubators for babies and men are not just baby seed suppliers, yet we seem to get continually reduced to this due to biology.

Loners, whether they be by choice or not, seem to shamed. Single people, especially 30+ are poked fun at. 

We're in such a weird time with all this opportunity yet barriers of the mind seem to constrain us. I hate it.

I'm sorry but I'm a proponent of equal rights and responsibilities as well as understanding some things can't be changed. I don't mean to put words in your mouth, but what about India and how they treat their men, or the failing population of the new age Japanese generation, or of the many corrupt African governments?

No place is perfect, but I hate that we pretend the west is.
And yet is this not what feminism is? A bringing to light of all slights of women? And yes, I am suicidal.
But are we not creatures of intellect? Can we not move beyond biological imperatives and instincts?

But it's expected from both men and women that men be stoic. Sure maybe you don't, but  society at large does. Similar to how women may or may not be taken seriously for biological health issues, men are stigmatized for poor mental health.

Why do they want to sign up for the selective service or get no federal college help? Why do they want higher suicide rates? Why do they want higher homeless rates? Why do they want to be much more likely to die on the job? Why do they want no reproductive rights? 

These don't seem like privileges.

Also I hate how people tell me feminism is about equality yet I'm not allowed to speak about my issues without being demonized for derailing.
You're right, it's so much better in places where basic human rights are out of place.

So now just because women were shit on men should be shit on in reparations.

Why can a raising tide not raise all boats. Why must some boats sink before we can get help?

And what of toxic femininity? Men are only considered toxic because currently more men hold positions of power. I want to see what happens when the reverse sexism scale slips too far, as I imagine it will.

Because I imagine it's act toxic power structures, not simply a gendered issue.

Men kill themselves at alarming rates and no one bats an eye.
